units.title: An explicit categorical-syllogistic calculus, with empty-term boundaries

required_components.description: Define the S and S-dagger languages and their set semantics.
required_components.success_condition: Give exact formula formation, complement roles and domain assumptions before the rule table.
required_components.failure_condition: Treat subject negation or arbitrary Boolean structure as licensed in the smaller S fragment.

required_components.description: Present both rule systems and prove their soundness and completeness.
required_components.success_condition: Supply all cases used by the source's Section 3 proof, including inconsistent premises and the reduction from S-dagger to S.
required_components.failure_condition: Import a first-order proof while leaving the promised direct syllogistic calculus unproved.

required_components.description: Provide a validity and existential-import lookup with countermodels.
required_components.success_condition: Give a worked derivation and a model with an empty predicate extension blocking illicit existential import.
required_components.failure_condition: Infer Some A are B from All A are B without an existence premise.

required_components.description: Separate the modern formal reconstruction from Aristotle's historical system.
required_components.success_condition: Link ED26-SRC-063-0102 and ED26-SRC-063-0103 and identify differing assumptions.
required_components.failure_condition: Attribute S/S-dagger unchanged to Aristotle or duplicate a whole SRC-063 history chapter.
